newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Royal Dutch/Shell eases.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Royal Dutch/Shell eases.

text.p: American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in Royal Dutch/Shell Group eased in New York on Friday after a ratings downgrade.
Trade in ADRS and foreign shares was quiet as the Dow industrials caught their breath from Thursday's record close.
"It's relatively slow, with a bit of profit-taking," a trader said. "There's no major movements anywhere -- it's Fridayish."
Royal Dutch Petroleum Co ADRs were off 2-1/2 to 180-1/2 after Merrill Lynch cut its rating on the company to long-term accumulate from buy. It kept Royal Dutch at near-term accumulate.
Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc fell 5/8 to 105-3/4. Merrill Lynch cut Shell to long-term accumulate from buy and kept it as a near-term accumulate.
Mexico's Grupo Televisa was off 7/8 to 25-3/4 after the group's chairman Emilio Azcarraga Milmo took leave for medical care.
Canadian mining company Barrick Gold Corp fell 1/2 to 26-1/2 amid rumors it had been frozen out of a big Indonesian gold project. The company was the most active among ADRS and foreign shares.
Decliners led advancers by 261 to 228 among 807 ADRs. Volume was 31.4 million shares just before midday.
